confidence_notes: Current aggregated Sarajevo prices support the restaurant, coffee and draft-beer anchors. Cocktail and wine estimates use local reported ranges in relation to the draft-beer baseline and are less aggregated. Accommodation values are holistic estimates without live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use direct Sarajevo prices. Accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Sarajevo as a budget-friendly Western Balkan capital with established tourist demand.
